title: Root safety block is core/AGENTS.md word for word, checked
goal: No requirement of the core safety block is missing from this repository
acceptance: A committed test fails first: safetyBlockDrift names each core line missing from AGENTS.md and each unmarked extra line; the test of the real AGENTS.md fails before the fix
AGENTS.md carries the core block verbatim; releasing and moving a published tag are lines marked <!-- project -->; check:template runs the comparison
escalation: A dropped or reworded safety requirement goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-26: test committed failing, then the block replaced. Closed 2026-11-26: #309 merged on green CI (main 1b23803, CI green on the merge commit); released in v10.24.1.
